subject.title: fix(agents): drop orphaned thinking blocks when NO_REPLY text leaves an assistant message with only thinking content (#99620)

question: Should OpenClaw land this narrow NO_REPLY-origin replay deletion now while leaving the canonical issue open for the separate orphaned-tool-result path, or require one generic adjacency invariant before accepting either fix?

options.title: Land the hardened narrow fix

options.title: Require a generic replay invariant
